summary: Transform your hospitality career with our Customer Service Excellence course. Gain essential skills to provide top-notch service and delight your guests!
lede: Customer Service Excellence in Hospitality helps you turn service efforts into consistent, measurable improvements across the guest journey. You will learn to assess performance, map experience touchpoints, set practical service targets, and identify the changes most likely to improve satisfaction, online reputation, repeat bookings, and revenue impact. The course builds practical capability in service standards, staff training, complaint resolution, performance measurement, and stakeholder reporting. Designed for real hospitality operations, it shows you how to strengthen service systems despite staff turnover, budget limits, seasonal changes, diverse guest expectations, and competing priorities.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who are directly responsible for, or accountable for, customer service performance across their hospitality operations.
modules: Service Recovery and Complaint Resolution Systems
Staff Training and Development for Service Excellence
Guest Experience Design and Journey Optimization
Digital Service Excellence and Online Reputation Management
Service Quality Assurance and Continuous Improvement
Service Excellence Strategy and Performance Reporting
prerequisites: While there are no formal prerequisites, participants will benefit most from this course if they have: Current experience in hospitality operations or guest-facing service roles; Basic understanding of hospitality business metrics and performance indicators; Access to guest satisfaction data, online review platforms, or operational service metrics for practical exercises; Authority or influence over service standards, staff training, or guest experience initiatives in their current role
